description: Team NeuroNauts empowers astronauts in microgravity by monitoring working memory, brain executive functions, mood, reaction time, and attention through real-time synthetic EEG analysis and gamified cognitive tasks. Our platform provides predictive health alerts and brain lobe-specific insights to ensure brain health and mission success.
summary:
Neuro-Health is a real-time cognitive monitoring and predictive digital twin platform built to safeguard astronaut brain health during deep-space missions. Developed by Team NeuroNauts, the web application integrates secure Facial Recognition sign-in, a NASA-calibrated Psychomotor Vigilance Test (PVT), spectral EEG analytics, and an interactive Sagittal MRI Brain Digital Twin mapping 14 anatomical regions and 6 neural circuit pathways.
In deep space, communication delays up to 22 minutes prevent real-time medical intervention from Earth, while microgravity, cosmic radiation, and circadian disruption silently erode vigilance and decision-making. Neuro-Health addresses this challenge autonomously by translating live reaction latency and EEG markers into eight real-time cognitive indicators, an EVA Readiness status, longitudinal trend charts (Current, 7-Day, and 30-Day), and environment-specific NASA safety protocols across ISS, Lunar, and Mars mission profiles.
By shifting space medicine from reactive care to predictive neural protection, Neuro-Health prevents fatal split-second errors in orbit—while offering scalable cognitive safeguarding for surgeons, pilots, and emergency responders on Earth.
details:
1. What It Does & How It Works

Neuro-Health is an autonomous, real-time cognitive telemetry and predictive brain digital twin platform engineered to monitor and protect astronaut neurological performance during deep-space missions.

  • Biometric Onboarding & PVT Assessment: Astronauts log in securely via Facial Recognition to load their personalized baseline. They then complete a rapid, NASA-calibrated Psychomotor Vigilance Test (PVT) measuring reaction latency (ms), attentional lapses, and false starts.
  • Spectral EEG & Multi-Domain Scoring: Our backend engine synthesizes PVT metrics with spectral EEG biomarkers (Delta, Theta, Alpha peak frequency, Beta, and Gamma power) to generate live scores (0–100) across eight cognitive and affective domains: Attention, Working Memory, Sleep Quality, Decision Making, Focus Level, Mood & Affective State, Sensory-Motor Reflex, and Concentration, alongside a color-coded EVA Readiness Status.
  • Interactive Sagittal MRI Brain Digital Twin: At the core of the dashboard sits an interactive Sagittal MRI Brain Visualizer mapping 14 anatomical regions (including the Frontal Lobe/DLPFC, Parietal Lobe, Thalamus, Hypothalamus, Hippocampus, Amygdala, Brainstem, and Cerebellum) and 6 dynamic neural circuit pathways (Mesolimbic, Visual, Cerebellar, Central Executive, Default Mode, and Stress/HPA). Users can toggle between MRI Anatomy and BOLD Activation Overlay and click any lobe to inspect regional activation and neurotransmitter balance.
  • Mission Context & Longitudinal Analytics: Astronauts can switch active mission environments (ISS Low Earth Orbit, Lunar Gateway, Lunar Surface, Mars Transit, and Mars Surface) to receive environment-specific gravity alerts, hazard warnings, and NASA-backed operational countermeasures, while tracking recovery across Current, 7-Day, and 30-Day longitudinal charts.

2. Key Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Autonomous Deep-Space Safety: On Mars missions with up to 22-minute one-way communication delays, real-time medical support from Earth is impossible. Neuro-Health acts as an onboard neural early-warning system, detecting silent cognitive drift before a 300-millisecond lapse during an EVA spacewalk or docking maneuver becomes fatal.
  • Preventive vs. Reactive Space Medicine: Instead of waiting for subjective fatigue reports, it prescribes immediate, evidence-based protocols (such as circadian light therapy, workload redistribution, or rest cycles) tailored to the astronaut's live neural state.
  • Terrestrial Spin-Off Impact: Beyond spaceflight, the exact same cognitive digital twin architecture can safeguard high-stakes operators on Earth—including neurosurgeons during marathon operations, commercial aviation pilots, air-traffic controllers, and disaster-response teams.

3. Tools, Coding Languages, Software & Scientific Data Used

  • Backend & Web Framework: Python, Django, SQLite/PostgreSQL, Gunicorn, WhiteNoise (deployed on Render cloud infrastructure).
  • Frontend & Data Visualization: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 5, Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 Canvas 2D Procedural MRI Rendering Engine, and Chart.js for longitudinal analytics.
    • NASA Psychomotor Vigilance Test (PVT) sleep-loss vigilance algorithms (Basner & Dinges).
    • NASA Human Research Program (HRP) Behavioral Medicine & SANS (Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome) evidence protocols.
    • NASA Twins Study spaceflight neurocognitive and circadian telemetry benchmarks.
    • Allen Human Brain Atlas sagittal anatomical coordinates and functional circuit pathways.

4. Creativity & Human-Centered Factors Considered

  • Creativity: Rather than displaying dry numerical tables, Neuro-Health transforms abstract EEG frequencies and reaction milliseconds into a living, pulsing Sagittal MRI Brain Digital Twin where neural pathways glow and accelerate in proportion to real-time cognitive load.
    1. Zero-Training Usability: Designed with intuitive color-coded thresholds (Green: 75–100 Optimal, Amber: 50–74 Caution, Red: 0–49 Deficit) so stressed crew members can interpret their readiness in under 3 seconds.
    2. Offline-First Resilience: Engineered to run locally inside spacecraft intranets without requiring continuous Earth internet connectivity.
    3. Environmental Specificity: Accounts for varying gravitational loads ($0.00g$, $0.16g$, $0.38g$), radiation exposure, and circadian disruption across distinct NASA mission phases.
